verdict.rationale: The engine is published to npm as `playcanvas` (`npm install playcanvas`). A runtime probe confirms version 2.22.2 under the MIT license with about 48k weekly downloads, and `create-playcanvas` scaffolds Vite + TypeScript projects that use the engine standalone as an ordinary bundled dependency. Older community comments that npm/ES module support was still in progress predate this and do not contradict the current npm package. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the engine is tree-shakeable (ESM side-effect-free builds), and independent hands-on corroboration of importing it into an existing bundler toolchain.
